title: Janïr yurkipan churatäki uka Suti
intro: Walja maranak suytʼasajj taqe chuyma achiktʼasiñamp phoqantat mä amuktʼat santuario ukham amuytʼañäni. Jan uñjat yänakatxa mä jaysäwiw juti, uka sutix janipuniw nayrax uñtʼatäkänti, nayrïr maranakatpach yatiñanïñwa arsuwayi, ukat Diosar katuyasiñampi, khuyaptʼayasiñampi ukat qʼuma sarnaqañamp uñtʼat jakañaw utjaraki.
clues: Nayax janïr yurkasax jupa pachpaw Allah sutimp uñt’ayawayta, uka sutix janipuniw nayat nayrax khitirus uñt’ayatäkänti.
Chuyman awk taykanakaw taqi chuyma mayisïwipar jaysañatak jaysapxitäna, jupanakax wawanakax janiw utjkaspati sasaw amuyapxäna.
Waynäkayäta ukhaw yatiñ kankañasa, taripäwisa, Qellqatanaksa churapjjetäna.
Nayajj awk taykajar sum uñjirïta ukat mayninakatsa khuyaptʼayasirïtwa, janiw jachʼa jachʼa tukurïkti ni jan istʼasirïkti.
Allah jupax nayarux sumankañ amtawayitu, kuna urutix yurkta, jiwañ uru, ukat jakkir jaktañ uru.
Zakariyya tatajax santuario (mihrab) ukan mayisiñan sayt’atäkasax angelanakatwa nayat kusiskañ yatiyäwinak katuqawayi.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
